newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes firmer on talk of Columbia buying.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes firmer on talk of Columbia buying.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed higher on Tuesday, boosted by talk Columbia's long-rumored rice purchases had gone through, traders said.
But export sources said the deal had not been completed. Columbia reportedly has been seeking 25,000 to 30,000 tonnes for March/April shipment, traders said.
Rice had traded lower in thin volume until a spurt of buying interest hit the market around 1305 CST, a trader said.
"LIT was an aggressive buyer and was also selling puts," a floor trader said. "They took us back to the top of resistance."
Fundamentally, rice stocks remain tight and planting projections of 2.9 million acres would do little to rebuild supplies, traders said.
Rice closed two to 11-1/2 cents per cwt higher with March up 10 at $11.99 per cwt. Volume was estimated by CBOT at 1,000 contracts, against Monday's actual volume of 1,040.
